newsitem.title: USA: CBOT oats close higher as commodity underpriced.
newsitem.headline: CBOT oats close higher as commodity underpriced.

text.p: CBOT oat futures closed higher with the market again boosted by belief that prices remain too low to generate significant oat seedings this year, traders said.
"July oats at $1.50 -- who wants to plant them at that level? No one," a trader said.

Traders noted speculation that Term Commodities was a key short in the March contract and expectations that deliveries against March could be light. First notice day for deliveries on the CBOT March contracts is February 28.
Commission houses bought at least 300,000 bushels of March and Cargill Investor Services bought 300,000 bushels of March, traders said.
Oat futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 2,000 contracts, about the same as the 1,954 traded Friday.
Oats closed 1-1/2 to 3-3/4 cents per bushel higher, with March up 3-3/4 at $1.67-1/2 and July up 2-1/4 at $1.52-1/4.
